group_note: ES II lineage, standalone (from 2026-07-29 bulk mudlib.rar drop; reskinned as Legend of the Galactic Heroes). A prior session's native-driver bring-up (documented in this lib's own NOTES.md) already fixed the segfaulting force-reload trick in master.lpc's create(), the §8.1 GBK byte-range is_chinese()/check_legal_name() bug, the /teature/ -> /feature/ directory typo, and a void-function-returning-a-value compile error in id_card.lpc, plus seeded the fluffos (admin) wizlist entry -- none of that was redone here. This WASM pass covered the remaining §7.x checks: (1) all three socket-touching daemons (adm/daemons/ftpd.lpc, adm/daemons/network/ftpd.lpc, adm/daemons/network/dns_master.lpc) are fully dormant -- commented out of adm/etc/preload, and DNS_MASTER's only two callers (cmds/adm/shutdown.lpc, cmds/wiz/mudlist.lpc) are wizard commands already guarded by find_object() checks -- left untouched, no gutting needed. (2) master.lpc's valid_read() already unconditionally returns 1 (no SECURITY_D delegation at all, so the new()-registration-hang bug pattern doesn't apply here); added the standard 'user == this_object()' short-circuit to valid_write() anyway for consistency with the rest of this session's libs. (3) §7.50 is_killing(object) vs is_killing(string id) fixed at cmds/std/surrender.lpc's one call site. is_chinese()/check_legal_name() were already correct (fixed in the earlier native-boot pass, not revisited). The one open item from the native-boot pass -- a non-blocking 'Too deep recursion' in securityd.lpc's valid_write(), reproducible on every login-object save via feature/dbase.lpc's default_ob fallback chain -- was reproduced again under WASM (identical signature/line numbers) and is still cosmetic-only: registration, world entry, and quit all complete successfully around it. Registration verified end-to-end pre- and post-formatter with a real Chinese name (id -> y confirm -> Chinese name -> password + confirm -> email -> gender -> enters 费沙中央宇宙港). Admin permission confirmed via existing fluffos/Mud@2026 credentials: '目前权限：(admin)'. LPC formatter run across all 834 .lpc files (821 written, 2 pre-existing errors, 11 unchanged). No :: parent-call split hits, no case-label-with-trailing-comment candidates, no CJK-respacing/broken-escape hits.
